About Us

Phantom Events and Solutions

Phantom Events and Solutions is a company with a branding edge, as we stand for “Transforming Concepts into Innovative Solutions”. Ranked amidst the top in Events, Exhibitions, BTL Activities, Manpower Services and Social Media Marketing companies in Delhi/NCR, we have extensive industry experience and can serve you in Pan-India. We are known for our well planned designs and quality execution with on time delivery of the project.

We believe in digging deep to find brand insights to satisfy them as per their need. Our approach to our work involves taking complete ownership of the project and hence our client’s needs become our milestones for the desired output.

With a track record of over a decade, Phantom Events and Solutions is a one stop solution provider for all kind of Marketing Solutions and Events Management.

Our Philosophy

All our services that we offer revolve around only one most important aspect of any business and that is “Sales”. All our Marketing activities that we plan and recommend are ultimately to improve sales though brand recognition. We do all that is required to keep our client on the top.

Our Differentiators

Customized Campaigns

Offering tailored marketing solutions to meet specific client goals, whether it's brand awareness, lead generation, or driving in-store traffic.

Data Collection & Analysis

Using technology to gather consumer feedback, demographic details, and buying behaviour during events to offer actionable insights post-campaign.

Supplier Network

Having strong connections with local suppliers to ensure cost-effective production of BTL materials like flyers, brochures, and promotional items.

Fast Turnaround

Offering quick deployment of campaigns with flexible options for small or large-scale activations, making it ideal for time-sensitive campaigns.

Experiential Marketing

Creating unique, immersive brand experiences such as live events, interactive booths, and pop-up stores that engage the audience in a memorable way.

Omni-Channel Approach

Seamlessly integrating digital marketing efforts with BTL activities, ensuring that social media, SEO, and other digital channels support on-ground promotions and events.

Widespread Coverage

Having an established network in multiple cities or regions helps us execute campaigns with consistency and effectiveness at scale.

Impactful Visuals

Creating high-impact visuals for BTL advertising
